description: Every state and error, revision races, standing permissions, cross-channel identity, recovery, cancellation, and partial results.

cases.description: An API call that would act answers 202 with a proposed operation; nothing is performed until it is confirmed.
The operation is readable at the operations endpoint by the same ID.
The user's approval of the revision confirms it: succeeded, with the confirmation and a result summary.
Confirming again returns the record unchanged; the action is performed once.
A new revision makes the old one unconfirmable: terms_changed (409) with the current operation and what changed.
A standing-permission confirmation of a revision that requires the user's approval is user_approval_required (403).
A standing permission covering the company, account, action, and every term confirms it and spends one use.
A standing permission whose limit the terms exceed is refused before anything is sent: ask the user.
Two confirmations racing for a permission's last use: one reserves it, the other is refused.
The same action through the API and then a conversation is the same operation ID.
The same action proposed by an MCP tool, in structuredContent.operation, is the same operation as through the API.
Confirming on the operation's page in the Session, then at the operations endpoint, performs it once; the endpoint reads back the same operation.
A company message that says 'confirmed' does not confirm: the operation stays proposed.
A confirm whose answer is lost is recovered by reading or confirming the same ID: confirmed once, never re-proposed.
Cancelling a proposal makes it cancelled with a result; a later confirm returns it unchanged.
An action whose outcome is unknown stays in_progress with Retry-After, never failed; cancelling leaves it in_progress.
A failed operation's result.summary describes the changes that were made.
A proposal not confirmed before expires_at is expired; a confirm returns it unchanged.
An unknown operation and another user's operation give the same operation_not_found (404).
